shared_elements: standing human figure, frontal, with arms out from the body
elongated linear object held or crossing the figure (spear / staff-like element)
depiction of a human head with headgear or radiating attribute
justification: Both surfaces depict frontal standing human figures with arms held away from the body, and both include a disc/concentric-circle element and a long staff- or spear-like linear form associated with a figure, but these are near-universal motifs. A shows tiny, stick-limbed, radically schematic figures scattered in an open field with a boat and animal signs, while B shows a single monumental, densely ornamented naturalistic personage with elaborate headdress, pectoral and interlocking scroll ornament filling every space — the depictive conventions and compositional density share nothing specific.
